49: ## How to Verify (Manual Checks)
50: 
51: ### A. Verify Prebooking Access Settings
52: 1. Open the Backoffice dashboard and go to **Outlet Users** -> click **Access Level** for a POS User.
53: 2. Scroll to the new **Prebooking** section (inserted after Pickup).
54: 3. Toggle **Customer Details Mandatory** ON.
55: 4. Save the Access Levels configuration.
56: 5. In the POS app, log in as that user. Go to the **PreOrder** tray tab.
57: 6. Check that name/mobile fields show asterisks (`*`) and checkout/KOT requires name/phone.
58: 7. Switch the user access setting OFF and check that details are optional again.
59: 
60: ### B. Verify Prebooking Print Preferences
61: 1. In the POS app, open **Settings** (Gear icon) -> select the **Printers** tab.
62: 2. Verify the checkboxes **Print customer copy for prebooking order** and **Print restaurant copy for prebooking order** are present.
63: 3. Try toggling them and check that they save.
64: 4. Make a prebooking order and print the receipt. Verify that separate copies labeled `(CUSTOMER COPY)` and `(RESTAURANT COPY)` print depending on the toggle choices.
